braid.name: stops
braid.description: Two routes share a straight 600 m street with stops on both sides: a same-name pair across the street, the same name again 250 m on, two different names facing each other, two unnamed stops, and one stop far from any route.
braid.expect: One bar across both lines per stop. The same-name pair shares one bar at x = 200; every other stop keeps its own bar where it is; the far stop gets none.
